messages:
OncallBot: INCIDENT ALERT — contbatch p99 latency spike in us-west-2 serving pool. Alert level: P2. Affected routes: /v1/stream-gen (streaming) and /v1/completion-contbatch. auto-run diagnostics.
Alex C: on it, pulling up batcher and kv metrics.
Maria G: paging @SRE Pager @Jin H — looks like customer-facing tail latency. :rotating_light:
SRE Pager: joining. any visible errors or just latency?
OncallBot: error rate nominal, but p95/p99 tokens latency increased sharply starting 2234567880. streaming stalls observed (stall after first chunk).
Alex C: grafana: batch_size distribution shifted right, lots of huge batches (~200-300) with mixed seq lengths. summary logs:
```text
[2234567891] batcher: batch_size=248 seq_mean=402 seq_std=320
[2234567892] runtime: kv-fetch=210ms, attn-kernel=90ms, stream-emit=120ms
[2234567893] stream: stalled after first-chunk for 3.2s
```
Jin H: that seq_std is the issue — mixed sequence lengths causing long-prep on some batches and streaming shards to block.
Maria G: immediate mitigations we should consider: reduce MAX_BATCH_SIZE, enable small-batch lane for streaming, tune scheduler fairness weights, and consider temporary routing to dedicated pool. who can push config?
Alex C: I can push a hotfix to scheduler + env. doing `MAX_BATCH_SIZE=64` for contbatch as a quick change.
Alex C: applying now:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/contbatch-worker MAX_BATCH_SIZE=64 
kubectl -n inference annotate deploy/contbatch-worker rtx-hotfix=contbatch-tail-2234
```
Alex C: rollout started — pods replacing, warming caches. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
SRE Pager: seeing partial p99 improvement on nodes that rolled. overall p99 dropped from ~5.1s -> ~3.2s on first hosts. residual tail on older pods.
Jin H: also applying scheduler tweak: `fairness.long_seq_weight=0.3` and enabling `small_batch_lane=true` so streaming requests preempt long batches.
Jin H: config snippet pushed:
```yaml
scheduler:
  fairness:
    long_seq_weight: 0.3
  small_batch_lane: true
```
OncallBot: runbook step executed: preemptive-kv-evict triggered on contbatch-usw2.
Alex C: KV eviction command run:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "$REDWOOD_CTRL/api/v1/evict_kv?pool=contbatch-usw2" || echo evict-failed
```
OncallBot: KV eviction complete, hit-rate recovering.
SRE Pager: I'm scaling up contbatch dedicated pool +2 nodes to reduce backlog and drain large batches. scaling request submitted.
Product Ops: is there confirmed customer impact (SLA triggers)? need to notify support/CS.
Alex C: brief impact summary: ~0.6% of streaming sessions saw stalls >5s during peak window. We set a checkpoint for any sustained >1% user impact and will escalate.
Maria G: support, prep a short advisory (what we changed + expected recovery). Jin, can you own customer triage list?
Jin H: ack. I'll run traces for any still-high traces and compile top-affected customer IDs. Also enabling a temporary alert to page if p99 > 4s for more than 2 minutes.
SRE Pager: added routing fallback in case of recurrence: route policy will send 20% traffic to `rv1-small` (lower-latency model) automatically if p99 >4s for 3 minutes.
Alex C: also opened a canary: route 20% of streaming to dedicated pool to smooth tail while workers roll.
OncallBot: realtime: p95 back to ~0.45s, p99 trending down to 2.1s over last 2 minutes.
Maria G: good progress. summary for handoff: reduced MAX_BATCH_SIZE, fairness tweak, enabled small-batch lane, KV eviction, +2 nodes, canary routing to dedicated pool. Estimated residual impact: minor, watch window 2h.
Maria G: handing off to @Jin H for overnight monitoring — I'll be offline in ~20m. please keep this thread updated with any anomalies. :pray:
Jin H: taking over. will monitor dashboards, keep alert thresholds adjusted, and collect traces. next steps for postmortem: improve seqlen bucketing, add adaptive batching threshold for streaming routes, and test preemptive small-lane at scale.
Product Ops: will draft support note and flag top 5 customers to CS. if SLA breaches confirmed, we'll coordinate legal and account teams.
SRE Pager: leaving escalation channel on-call. if p99 climbs above 4s again, enable automatic model fallback and consider temporary rate-limit shedding for mixed-seqlen heavy routes.
Alex C: posting immediate follow-ups to tickets: INF-8273 (batcher fairness refactor), INF-8274 (per-route small-lane config), INF-8275 (seqlen histogram telemetry).
OncallBot: final automated update: aggregate p99 now 2.05s across 95% nodes, backlog drained by +15% capacity.
Maria G: thanks all — excellent quick mitigation. I'll write a short incident blurb and add to postmortems later.
Jin H: will append traces and exact timestamps to this thread before EOD. closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
Product Ops: thanks team, closing for now. :thumbsup:
